issues.description: In Openshift PCI devices with no iommu support for VFIO, the DPDK fails to unbind until all processes have stopped using the PCI devices.
Comm crash is observed in CN-DB, CN-GW, CN-MGMT pods during a CN-MGMT failover.
CN-NGFWs and CN-MGMTs fail to establish connection on some Openshift environments due to some conditions listed in Openshift bug.
In Open shift environments, it is observed that ping packets from CN-GW pods to/from external environments are dropped.
The inbound traffic to secured applications fails to work with PAN-CNI 3.0.3 and 3.0.4 for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
issues.workaround: Use PAN-CNI 3.0.2 for AKS to deploy the CN-Series firewall successfully.

issues.description: When onboarding an OpenShift 4.15 cluster, the cluster validation fails with an SSL certificate error.
issues.workaround: If the Kubernetes plugin cannot connect to the Kubernetes API server, use IP address instead of DNS name in the API server configuration setup.
